name: Jonas Žemaitis
realm: President of the Republic of Lithuania
positions: President of the Republic of Lithuania
extract: Jonas Žemaitis, also known under his nom de guerre Vytautas (March 15, 1909 – November 26, 1954), was a Lithuanian general and partisan who served as the president of Lithuania from 1949 until his death in 1954. A Lithuanian partisan, armed resister of Soviet occupation, and the chairman of the Union of Lithuanian Freedom Fighters, Žemaitis was posthumously nominated and acknowledged as the head of state of Lithuania following the re-establishment of Lithuanian independence.
wp_description: Acting president of Lithuania from 1949 to 1954
